subject: Re: CNC kickoff — learned normalized cuts for corpus clustering
body:
Anders,

Plan:

Staffing — Umar 40% (method owner, loss + training); Quentin 50% (reproduction and the bake-off harness — good growth project for him with Umar reviewing); Farah 35% through April (training infra); Wanjiru 30% (affinity-graph construction from the production shard, plus the Corpus work below).

Compute — small models, the cost is in affinity-graph construction, which is CPU/data work. 8 A100s best-effort covers all training.

Heads-up on the one platform dependency: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, so the affinity-graph tables must be migrated before our window even ends — Wanjiru will run that migration in late May so we're not scrambling. I'd rather eat the week now than discover in July that we're pinned to v1 tables nobody maintains.

Jelena
